description: Search the one-click installer catalog for a game: modpacks (e.g. FTB, All the Mods), server variants and mod loaders (e.g. Paper, Forge, Fabric). Each result has a file_id and its latest release. Pass a file_id to create_instance to install it on a new server, or to list_file_releases for older versions. `base_game` is the game itself; its file_id also works with list_file_releases to pick an older game version.

game.description: Game slug, e.g. "minecraft". Must match a slug from get_game or list_instances.

limit.description: How many results to return. Defaults to 20, at most 100.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the name, e.g. "ftb evolution" or "atm10". Omit to list the most installed files.

name: search_game_files
title: Search Modpacks & Server Versions
